messages:
kevin: Spike idea: add a "query-path" tab in Cost Explorer that attributes token spend to the full routing path (route -> routing_policy -> selected_sku -> prefetch delta). Want quick alignment on telemetry + export shape.

maya: 👍. Two constraints: keep per-event payload tiny and give finance a reproducible CSV. Suggest qpath_id reference + lightweight per-request event.

oliver: Agree. For fallbacks include both chosen_sku and final_sku and a fallback_reason. Otherwise cache credits flip-flop when fallback triggers.

rachel: UX: default external view = single credited owner, internal view = apportioned by prefetch lineage. Show a small badge when numbers are estimated.

kevin: Telemetry proposal: emit per-request: qpath_id (required), route, tokens_in, cache_hit (bool), final_sku (optional). Store lineage doc per qpath_id off-band. Sampling: exact for last 10m, 1m rollups to 24h, reservoir beyond.

maya: For indexing, qpath_id should be a stable 64-bit hash string. We'll route it to a low-cardinality index and allow redaction for public traces.

oliver: Export needs: CSV columns qpath_id, credited_sku, apportioned_cost_usd, credited_cost_usd, sample_method, confidence_pct. Finance will use a reconciliation key.

rachel: Add a simulation widget: slider to reassign X% traffic between SKUs and project monthly delta in token spend + expected cache-hit changes, based on recent 7d sample. Show ± confidence band.

kevin: Implementation note: prefer storing lineage in a compact store keyed by qpath_id rather than embedding in each event to avoid blowing up ingestion. Ingest shim will materialize lineage when it sees new qpath_id.

maya: Ops: can we stage schema "querypath-lineage-v1" to a canary? Want to validate indexing cost before full rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: schema "querypath-lineage-v1" staged to canary 'canary-nyc' in 3m :rocket:

oliver: Small UX ask: in the expanded table include sample_rate and recent_median_latency per qpath row so product can triage noisy paths.

rachel: Also add an admin toggle to include_apportioned boolean in export API. Default export returns both columns but flag controls which column is labeled primary.

kevin: I'll write a short RFC with telemetry contract, sample math for apportioned credits, export CSV spec, and wireframes. If anyone objects to apportioned default internal, shout now.

maya: +1 apportioned internal default.

oliver: +1

rachel: +1

kevin: Filing RFC now.
